name: Desk arm
summary: A small arm that moves to a set of saved poses.

safety.text: Pinch hazard at the joints. Keep fingers clear while the arm moves.

steps.title: Assemble the joints
steps.body: Fit each servo horn at the centre position before tightening the screws.

steps.title: Wire the servos
steps.body: Power the servos from their own supply, not from the Pi, and share the ground.

steps.title: Save poses
steps.body: Move the arm by hand into each pose and press the button to save it.
